snippet.title: “Vanishing Starlight” New PV. See you at Gamescom！
snippet.description:
New Metroidvania “Vanishing Starlight”
An death row prisoner who lost memory ventures to reclaim what's lost. Under the oppression of the “Gods”, what path will you choose?
Gamepoch with “Vanishing Starlight” welcome you on Gamescom.
From Aug. 20-24, join us at Hall 10.1 Booth F072, Koelnmesse, for an unforgettable experience!
